name: 16 computers , cpu, keyboard and screen
description:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Donation of 16 Desktop Computer Sets for Students and Community Use 

I would like to enquire whether there are students and community who might benefit from having a computer at home for their learning and educational needs.

Giving Our Computers a Second Life – Supporting Students and the Community

KPW Singapore Pte Ltd is a process mechanical contractor operating on Jurong Island. Following the successful completion of our projects and demobilisation from the site, we have 16 desktop computer sets available for donation, each comprising a CPU, monitor and keyboard.

Rather than leaving these computers unused, we hope to give them a second life by making them available to students and community  who may need a computer at home, or for other educational and community purposes.

If  your organisation is able to identify suitable recipients, we would be happy to donate the computers and arrange delivery at a mutually convenient time. We hope this small contribution can help students or community with their studies and provide useful support to those who may not otherwise have access to a computer.

A Note on the Computers

The hard disks have been reformatted, with storage space cleared for new programmes. We can also bring along the original software available with the computers, allowing your IT personnel to select and install suitable programmes as required.

We would be grateful if you could let us know whether this donation would be useful to your students or organisation.

Thank you for your time and for the valuable work you do in supporting students and the community. We hope these computers can find new homes where they will be put to good use.

Thank You And Warm Regards; With A Good Day And Great Days Ahead
